findings.issue: NFR-010 (login p95 <= 400 ms) is not demonstrated. p95 measured 940 ms at c=1 and 1634 ms at c=5, but standalone argon2.verify reaches 1025 ms p95 on the same host with under 1 GB RAM free, so the run describes memory starvation rather than the login path. A certifiable run needs several GB free and Redis up; the report's section 7 carries the exact command. Disclosed to the human and accepted at the decision gate.

.sdrive/audit-log.json is the only uncommitted path in the tree. Every sdrive command appends a hash-chained entry, so the evidence run that C06 requires necessarily dirties it - the same tension that made test-evidence.json gitignored. The project should pick a policy: ignore the log, or commit the appended entry during /sdrive:archive.

CI has never produced a green run. No run exists for feature/auth-onboarding or for HEAD 940189d; the workflow triggers on main/master pushes and pull requests only, and the reviewer may not open a PR. Both historical main runs failed after 9 s and 11 s.
